game_concept: A card battler set in Eldritch Ruins – Weathered Gate, a weathered stone gate: the ruin warden must handle eldritch shades while practicing lists. Core idea – Mutation Mystery: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Weathered Gate: a weathered stone gate
core_gameplay_loop: In Weathered Gate, repeat each round: Spot when two names point to the same list and when copy() is needed. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the mutation_safe value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about mutation_safe to power up the ruin warden and open the relic vault.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 9 (extended tier): Mutation Mystery
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mutation Mystery' (Week 7 slot 15), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Weathered Gate'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how mutation_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against eldritch shades in Weathered Gate.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
